about_the_game:
🧿 Pal Engine — Your Interactive 3D Desktop Companion

Pal Engine brings animated 3D characters to your desktop — customizable, expressive, and optionally AI-powered.
Use built-in characters or import your own VRM model, define their personality, control their behavior, and make them uniquely yours.

🤝 Community-Driven Development

Built with the community, for the community.
Share feedback, suggest features, contribute VRM models, animations, and ideas — and help shape the future of Pal Engine.

🔑 Key Features

🎭 Load & personalize VRM characters — import your own avatar or use one of the built-in Alenia models. Customize name, appearance, interests, and personality.

🖱️ Drag, resize & rotate freely — move your character between screens, scale and rotate, switch between Perspective & Orthographic cameras.

💬 Optional AI Chat — each character responds with its own memory, tone, and style.

🎞️ Advanced Animation System

  • Idle Animations — set your default idle, or let characters cycle through random idles.

  • Custom Animations — add your own dances, actions, and gestures (FBX & VRMA).

  • Dance Control — choose which dances are included in random dance playback.

  • Interactions & Reactions — assign unique actions/gestures for clicks on head, hands, legs, and more.

🛠️ What’s Coming Next

😀 Facial Expressions — smile, frown, react with emotion.
📐 Snap-to-screen Docking — sit at bottom, lean on sides.
⏰ Utilities — notes, timers & alarms.
🎬 Support for more custom user-defined animations.
🔊 Text-to-Speech — characters reply with voice.

✨ Pal Engine isn’t just a tool — it’s your desktop, with personality.
